overview.text: Demerike "Demi" Palecek is an Air Force veteran, an active member of the Army National Guard, president of the 46th Ward Democrats, and a former communications manager for a state representative. Her campaign says she supports expanding access to abortion care, contraception, and fertility treatment; rent control and affordable housing; and expanded mental health care. In a Chicago Sun-Times questionnaire, she said she publicly opposed using National Guard troops for immigration enforcement and is under military investigation for her stance.
